posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers TechCrunch AI · 🟧 Claude · 5h ago • Claude users' accounts are being compromised, with hackers stealing API tokens without authorization. • Anthropic has issued warnings to affected subscribers after a user discovered unauthorized token consumption. • Token theft allows attackers to use victims' API credits for their own purposes. 📰 Also covered by: The Verge – AI Read more →
